title: AGENTS.md frontmatter
description: Machine-parseable YAML frontmatter block of any AGENTS.md file in an osEngineer-initialised workbench, repo, or team folder. The top-level oneOf discriminates by the 'scope' field. Each branch allows additionalProperties so individual repos can extend the contract without false rejections from the linter.

semver.description: Semantic version string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release / build metadata) as defined by semver.org.

slug.description: Lowercase-with-hyphens identifier. Used for team_id and agent slugs. Must start with a lowercase letter.

schemaVersion.description: Frontmatter contract version. Currently always 1; bumped only on breaking schema changes.

pathString.description: Filesystem path (relative or absolute). Always a plain string; null/missing values must be omitted entirely rather than set to null.

pathArray.description: Array of path globs. Each entry is a glob pattern such as 'src/**/*.go' or 'docs/'.

slugArray.description: Array of slug identifiers (agent slugs or team_ids).

metaRef.description: Reference to the Codified Source of Truth (META) repo. May be either a plain path string or an object carrying an explicit role label.

role.description: What this META repo plays in the workbench (e.g. 'codified-source-of-truth', 'graphify-target').

repoEntry.description: Single repo entry inside a workbench-scope frontmatter's repos: list.

path.description: Relative path to the repo root from the workbench root.

teamEntry.description: Single team entry inside a repo-scope frontmatter's teams: list. Declares which agents serve the team, what file globs the team owns / reads / excludes, and which other teams it escalates to.

team_id.description: Team identifier. Matches the team folder name when one exists; matches a team-* template name for glob-only teams.

folder.description: Filesystem folder this team operates from. Null for glob-only teams (e.g. testing) that have no single owning folder.

agents.description: Agent slugs that serve this team (e.g. 'developer', 'reviewer', 'tester').

owns_paths.description: Globs of paths this team owns. The pre-edit-guard blocks edits outside owns_paths during execute phase.

reads_paths.description: Globs of paths this team may read but not edit.

excludes.description: Globs subtracted from owns_paths. Useful when an inner folder belongs to another team.

escalates_to.description: Team identifiers (or 'user') this team escalates to when a handoff is needed.

workbenchScope.description: Workbench-level AGENTS.md frontmatter. Lives at the workbench root and lists which repos belong to the workbench.

osengineer_version.description: osEngineer release that produced this manifest.

repos.description: Inventory of repos in this workbench.

cross_repo_handoffs_dir.description: Folder under which cross-repo handoff tickets live (XR-<n>-<slug>.md).

repoScope.description: Repo-level AGENTS.md frontmatter. Lives at a repo root and declares the team folder map plus phase state file.

architect.description: Whether this repo has its own architect agent. When true the architect is invoked for repo-scope routing; when false the workbench architect is used.

osengineer_version.description: osEngineer release that produced this manifest.

project_classification.description: Size / shape classification used to choose default agent set and parallelism limits.

teams.description: Per-folder team declarations for this repo.

phase_state_file.description: Path to the YAML file tracking phase state (default: ./.osengineer/state.yml).

teamScope.description: Team-level AGENTS.md frontmatter. Lives inside a team folder and declares per-folder ownership for the team.

team_id.description: Team identifier (must match a team_id declared in the parent repo's teams: list).

parent_repo.description: Relative path to the owning repo root (commonly '../').

agents.description: Agent slugs that serve this team.

owns_paths.description: Globs of paths this team owns inside the parent repo.

reads_paths.description: Globs of paths this team may read but not edit.

escalates_to.description: Team identifiers (or 'user') this team escalates to when a handoff is needed.
